articles.summary: For more than 50 years, Chili's® Grill Bar has been the mainstay for first dates, post-game dinners, birthday celebrations and parking lot hangs. And lately, the grill bar has been bringing fresh energy to that familiar experience with craveable menu updates, better service and livelier restaurants. With Chili's gaining new fans like never before and tasting, looking and feeling better than ever, it's time to give guests a new way to wear their Chili's love beyond the booth. "Streetwear has dominated mainstream fashion for years, but now we're starting to see suburban wear have its moment as more consumers are drawn to relaxed, comfort-first fits," said Jesse Johnson, vice president of marketing at Chili's. "For decades, Chili's has shaped suburban culture with our come-as-you-are relaxed atmosphere, so who better to celebrate suburban style with our new merch collection." articles.title: Chili's® Turns Decades of Defining Suburb Culture into Style with the "Suburban Collection" Merch Line

articles.summary: Over the past 24 years, Chili's® Grill Bar guests and Team Members across the country have embraced Chili's decades-long commitment to St. Jude Children's Research Hospital ®. Today, that tradition continues with a new pledge to help raise $150 million over the next 15 years to help support children and families facing cancer and other life-threatening diseases. The partnership has always been powered by people. From Team Members who launched the first Create-A-Pepper fundraiser in Memphis in 2002 to the millions of guests who have donated in restaurants across the country, each contribution has helped St. Jude push the overall childhood cancer survival rate in the U.S. from 20% in 1962 to more than 80% today. Together, that generosity has helped fund spaces on the St. Jude campus that drive research, patient care and education every day. articles.title: Chili's® Announces Historic $150 Million Commitment to St. Jude Children's Research Hospital®, Fueled by Guests and Team Members

articles.summary: Brinker International, Inc. (NYSE: EAT) will host its 2026 Investor Day at its headquarters in Dallas, Texas today beginning at 8:30 a.m. CT.
